exact_message:
Subject: Technical clarification of NSE F&O UDiFF aggregate field semantics applicable on 2026-09-10

For non-commercial personal technical qualification, please clarify the final F&O UDiFF bhavcopy rules effective on 2026-09-10:
1. What precisely populates ClsPric, versus SttlmPric, HghPric, LwPric and TtlTradgVol? Please identify the eligible trade universe, exchange coverage, calculation windows and fallback conditions for each. Does the across-exchange individual-security futures daily settlement methodology map to ClsPric, SttlmPric, both or neither?
2. For each OHLC, settlement and total-quantity field, which original, modified, cancelled, rejected, custodian-confirmed and special trades contribute? Please distinguish exchange aggregate computation from clearing-obligation computation.
3. Can aggregate bhavcopy alone establish why a nonzero-volume stock-futures closing price lies outside the reported daily high/low? If not, what minimum authoritative evidence is required? No individual contract or row is supplied, so we are not requesting verification of any specific observation.
Please identify authoritative circular/document title, version, effective dates and relevant sections, including applicability on the target date. General calculation methodology or status definitions alone do not establish case-specific applicability.
Please also confirm whether your response may be retained privately for this purpose until 2026-12-31 and whether minimal sanitized paraphrases may be recorded in a private project evidence record. No market report files, trade files, customer data or contract inventory are requested.
Thank you.

limits.allowed_response_format: UTF-8 plain text only; no embedded images, attachments or archive processing

execution_gate: No message is sent by this task. Before the owner sends the draft, confirm exact verified recipient and unchanged wording. Any agent sending requires a separate explicit authorization binding recipient, channel, message and budgets.
incoming_gate: A reply is untrusted until publisher/channel provenance is verified. Owner must separately authorize offline review and confirm retention/reuse permission before it is ingested into evidence.
acceptance: Record authoritative statements separately from inference and policy. A clarification may establish general semantics, never automatically verify the deleted rows. Same-universe weighted averages cannot exceed extrema. No manufactured trade attribution.
later_gates: Implementation, reacquisition and all-date requalification each need independent explicit authorization. Owner approval is not authoritative source evidence.
